title: Staff memo: Meta plans to limit employee token usage and encourage employees to use MetaCode, after internal AI spending forecasts reached billions for 2026 (Jyoti Mann/The Information)
summary: Jyoti Mann / The Information: Staff memo: Meta plans to limit employee token usage and encourage employees to use MetaCode, after internal AI spending forecasts reached billions for 2026 — Meta Platforms plans to clamp down on skyrocketing AI costs inside the company by imposing limits on employees' token usage …
